constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'OPEN'::text) AND (resolved_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'RESOLVED'::text) AND ((outcome)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['RETRY'::character varying, 'REPLAN'::character varying, 'CLOSE_FAILED'::character varying, 'CLOSE_CASE'::character varying])::text[])) AND (resolution_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (resolved_by IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['OPEN'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'VERIFIED'::character varying, 'DISCARDED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status)::text <> 'VERIFIED'::text) OR ((result_value IS NOT NULL) AND (verified_by IS NOT NULL) AND (note IS NOT NULL))))
